elements.requirement: An employee is entitled to be permitted by their employer to take a reasonable amount of time off during their working hours to take action that is necessary for specified dependant-related reasons.
elements.quote: An employee is entitled to be permitted by his employer to take a reasonable amount of time off during the employee’s working hours in order to take action which is necessary

elements.requirement: An employee may take time off to provide assistance on an occasion when a dependant falls ill, gives birth, or is injured or assaulted.
elements.quote: to provide assistance on an occasion when a dependant falls ill, gives birth or is injured or assaulted

elements.requirement: An employee may take time off to make arrangements for the provision of care for a dependant who is ill or injured.
elements.quote: to make arrangements for the provision of care for a dependant who is ill or injured

elements.requirement: An employee may take time off to take necessary action in consequence of the death of a dependant.
elements.quote: in consequence of the death of a dependant

elements.requirement: An employee may take time off because of the unexpected disruption or termination of arrangements for the care of a dependant.
elements.quote: because of the unexpected disruption or termination of arrangements for the care of a dependant

elements.requirement: An employee may take time off to deal with an incident that involves their child and that occurs unexpectedly during a period when an educational establishment attended by the child is responsible for that child.
elements.quote: to deal with an incident which involves a child of the employee and which occurs unexpectedly in a period during which an educational establishment which the child attends is responsible for him

elements.requirement: An employee is not entitled to take time off unless the employee tells their employer the reason for the absence as soon as reasonably practicable.
elements.quote: tells his employer the reason for his absence as soon as reasonably practicable

elements.requirement: An employee is not entitled to take time off unless the employee tells their employer for how long the employee expects to be absent, except where informing the employer of the reason for absence cannot be complied with until after the employee has returned to work.
elements.quote: except where paragraph (a) cannot be complied with until after the employee has returned to work, tells his employer for how long he expects to be absent

elements.requirement: A dependant of an employee means the employee's spouse or civil partner, child, parent, or a person who lives in the same household as the employee other than by reason of being the employee's employee, tenant, lodger, or boarder.
elements.quote: a spouse or civil partner , (b) a child, (c) a parent, (d) a person who lives in the same household as the employee, otherwise than by reason of being his employee, tenant, lodger or boarder

elements.requirement: For the purposes of providing assistance when ill, giving birth, injured, or assaulted, or making care arrangements when ill or injured, a dependant also includes any person who reasonably relies on the employee for assistance on an occasion when that person falls ill or is injured or assaulted, or to make arrangements for the provision of care in the event of illness or injury.
elements.quote: any person who reasonably relies on the employee— (a) for assistance on an occasion when the person falls ill or is injured or assaulted, or (b) to make arrangements for the provision of care in the event of illness or injury

elements.requirement: For the purposes of unexpected disruption or termination of care arrangements, a dependant also includes any person who reasonably relies on the employee to make arrangements for the provision of care.
elements.quote: any person who reasonably relies on the employee to make arrangements for the provision of care

elements.requirement: Any statutory reference in the provision to illness or injury includes a reference to mental illness or injury.
elements.quote: A reference in this section to illness or injury includes a reference to mental illness or injury
